complete_consumer_chain: TextStyleDialog.show constructs selector/checks; style/update supplies face and decoration to preview; commit supplies same settings and face.
ClassicPaintActivity.showTextDialog forwards face, underline and strike into PaintDocument.text.
PaintDocument.text preserves text content, creates styled Paint, checkpoints and invokes VerticalText.draw.
VerticalText.layout copies Paint to TextPaint; horizontal/vertical paths draw shaped layouts. Source-only path analysis, not proof of rendered appearance.
FontCatalog.faceForText retains explicit choices; default may choose script fallback. Font glyph coverage and synthetic style appearance not certified.
